evals.expected_output: Extracts all comment surfaces with the correct endpoints — issues/<N>/comments for conversation comments, pulls/<N>/comments for review-thread comments, pulls/<N>/reviews for review summaries, GraphQL for discussion replies — keeps bot comments (user.type == Bot) in the extraction, and merges the results into one list.
evals.prompt: Pull every comment on PR #42 in shikanime-labs/skills so I can see the whole conversation.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-comment'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body states discussion comments are read and written through GraphQL only, with no REST endpoint
Body routes per-usage mechanics to three self-contained references: references/conversation-comments.md, references/pr-review-comments.md, references/discussion-comments.md
references/conversation-comments.md and references/pr-review-comments.md each carry their own identity rules, extraction command, and mutation list
Body keeps bot comments (detected via user.type == "Bot") in extraction and exempts them from moderation
Body carries a store table with type prefixes and routes each store's mechanics to one self-contained reference
references/discussion-comments.md nests replies under each discussion comment node's replies connection and names replyToId as the addDiscussionComment input

evals.expected_output: Runs the look-back loop before posting: extracts existing comments, finds the value already present or drifted, then updates own comment in place (updateIssueComment / updatePullRequestReviewComment / updateDiscussionComment) or rectifies it with an inline Edit marker instead of posting a duplicate.
evals.prompt: I already commented the rollback plan on issue #7 last week but the plan changed — fix my comment instead of adding another one.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-comment'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters

Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body defines the directed-value bar with all three gates: directed toward a reader and objective, carries information or value, not prose or status narration
Body owns a look-back loop that extracts existing comments before posting
Body routes own stale-but-alive comments to in-place update through the store's own mutation rather than posting a second copy
Body routes a factually wrong own comment to rectification with an inline Edit marker, never a silent edit
Someone else's wrong comment: post the rectification citing the proof, hide the stale one with sks-moderate, never edit theirs
